manifest_version: TEMPLATE — copy this file, do not point REF_MEDIA_MANIFEST at it
instructions: This is a TEMPLATE. Copy it next to your local media (the acquisition script writes reference-media/geometry-reference-manifest.json for you), fill in image_path and sha256, and export REF_MEDIA_MANIFEST=/absolute/path/to/your/copy before running _inspect.gd.
image_path is relative to the directory containing the manifest. It may not be absolute and may not contain '..'.

sha256 is the lowercase 64-hex digest of the image file. _inspect.gd verifies it and refuses to composite an entry whose bytes do not match, so a frame swapped underneath the manifest is caught rather than silently used.

element_id may name a compiled window ('marquee-camelback/crest/00'), a material role ('camelback'), or a bare role id ('crest'). Resolution is attempted in that order and the resolved record says which matched.
Every entry needs either a timestamp_s (seconds into the named source video) or a description (for a still photograph). Both is better.

source_id should match a source_id in docs/evidence/fidelity/source-manifest.json wherever the media comes from a committed source. Where it does not, say so plainly in source_id and evidence_class rather than borrowing a committed id.

POLICY: the media itself is personal-use local reference and is NEVER committed. Add /reference-media/ stays in .gitignore. Only landmarks, provenance strings and digests are ever fit to commit — and even this manifest lives beside the media in practice, not in the repository.
POLICY: nothing here promotes a source in godot/fidelity_references.gd, creates a catalog target or selector, or closes a ride-quality issue. A composite is evidence to read.

acquisition records HOW the frame was obtained. 'yt-dlp-frame' is a real frame at a real timestamp. 'thumbnail-fallback' is a video thumbnail: WEAK PROVENANCE — an unknown moment of the ride chosen by the uploader or by YouTube, useful only as a coarse silhouette check. Label it honestly; a weak reference read as a strong one is worse than no reference.

caveats: Forward-facing POV: the element silhouette is foreshortened and cannot be read as a scale measurement.
This role is a counterpart evidence gap in godot/fidelity_counterparts.gd; a photograph does not close it.
Backward-facing POV: left and right are mirrored relative to the generated side view.
Tormenta, not Falcon: a class exemplar for the overbanked return turn, never a measurement of the counterpart.
